notes.title: Penny's Big Breakaway 1.2.20240313 is now live
notes.content:
Penny's Big Breakaway 1.2.20240313 is now live

This is a hotfix build with the following changes:
- Adjusted ice physics behavior and turn momentum
- Fixed the catcher's mitt crash when using Hot Rod Pepper power-up
- Fixed a progression block in Gala Night 1 where suction pipe doesn't send Penny high enough
- Fixed input lock that could occur by pressing left face button on the main menu
- Reinforced the fix to the Player Cannon in World's Edge

Thanks for your patience and support!

notes.title: Penny's Big Breakaway v1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Today, we released a patch that fixes several issues. It also includes updates and improvements to existing functions. Please make sure to update your game to the latest version.

In lieu of the changes below, [b]we will be resetting the leaderboards for 4-2[/b]. This patch introduces a fix to a bug that existed on this level which allowed players to skip a large portion of the level. 

We will continue to monitor the game for future fixes and patches, but in the meantime, thanks for playing Penny's Big Breakaway!

Penny has been practicing her performances! She will no longer…
[list]
[*] Get stuck on wall ledges and other objects.
[*] Infinitely fall to her death in the World’s Edge boss encounter.
[*] Slide up slopes that aren’t the ground.
[*] Get stuck in a temporary infinite skid.
[*] Get disconnected from YoYo during Whirl.
[*] Lose all momentum when starting a yoyo ride from a distance.
[*] Infinitely tumble.
[*] Lose all her velocity when transitioning from Dash to Ride after YoYo retraction.
[*] Get stuck at the end of a zipline when holding Ride or Throw until released. 
[/list]
Furthermore, YoYo has been training and will…
[list]
[*] Stop going through as many walls when thrown.
[*] Now accelerate more consistently while swinging in higher frame rates.
[*] Be correctly sized on the Zipline.
[*] Ledge Grab on more surfaces.
[*] Stop releasing Penny from Edge Grab too early.
[/list]
We’ve also asked the denizens to do some repairs and upgrades in the world. Here’s what they’ve been working on…

IMPROVEMENTS: 
[list]
[*] Omitted video settings from cloud saves – they’re only stored locally now!
[*] Added Fullscreen video option.
[*] From now on, we will reset the global cycle timer when restarting or dropping out
[*] Indicate all-time cleared Show Pieces/Dilemmas for a scene in Pause menu.
[*] Added a quick restart feature to Time Attack – Just hold the top face button!
[*] Made Gusto reset to max when dropping out in Time Attack.
[*] Game elements will behave more deterministically when you’re navigating Time Attack (by using a consistent global random seed when restarting or dropping out).
[*] Reminded the denizens to not start the timer until Penny leaves Start Platform in Time Attack.
[*] Scrapbook photos will now be full screen when viewing in menu!
[*] Added the ability to delete Scrapbook unlock progress.
[*] Added Depth of Field video option.
[*] Tinkered with the Turnstile so Penny is consistently launched from the intended release point.
[*] Adjusted the Rolling Log to not cause tumble when impacting sloped surface.
[/list]
REPAIRS:
[list]
[*] Repaired the Suction Pipe so that it will now always eject Penny with the intended motion.
[*] Politely asked the Peng Balloon to not cause a soft lock at the end of Pengoville 2 when falling on Penny after landing on the Busker Stage.
[*] Reminded the Scatter Birds that their shadows should not disappear for a frame before flying away.
[*] Turned around the Whirl Screw in the Final Act so that it screws in the correct direction.
[*] Fixed the HUD so it will no longer draw after transitioning offscreen.
[*] When opening pause menu the same frame Penny drops out, the stage will now play music properly.
[*] Fixed the water splash VFX.
[*] Fixed visual issues with the Fail Transition.
[*] Corrected the Cannon object so that it no longer points to invalid target object references.
[*] Whacked the side of the boombox so that the SFX issue after defeating [spoiler]Judge Rufus[/spoiler] no longer occurs.
[*] Oiled the grease on the ball bearings so that vertical camera movement now always tracks at the correct speed (camera slack delta time scaling).
[/list]
—

notes.title: Ready, set, YO!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Evening Star here!

You may know some of our team from their work on Sonic Mania and if so, hello again!

We've been diligently working behind the scenes, pouring our passion into crafting something entirely fresh and exciting. Today, we are absolutely ecstatic to finally lift the curtain and share the news we've been eagerly anticipating. 

It is with great joy that we present to you our original 3D platformer, Penny's Big Breakaway!

Join us as we introduce you to Penny, a street performer with dreams as big as her personality, and her lively companion, Yo-Yo, as they take center stage in the mesmerizing world of Macaroon.

In this vibrant 3D-platformer, Penny finds herself entangled in an audition for Palace Court Performers. Little does she know, a Cosmic String transforms her trusted Yo-Yo into a lively creature, setting the stage for an unforgettable escapade. Together, Penny and Yo-Yo must clear her name, outwit the eccentric Emperor's penguin army, and unravel the secrets of the Cosmic String.

Game Highlights:
[list]
[*][b]Expressive Gameplay: [/b]Prepare to showcase your skills as you unleash a captivating array of tricks and combos, dazzling the audience with Penny and Yo-Yo's sensational performances. It's time to steal the spotlight and become the star you were born to be!
[*][b]Explore the World of Macaroon:[/b] Immerse yourself in the enchanting realm of Macaroon, where imagination knows no bounds. Traverse stunning landscapes, discover hidden secrets, and let your star power shine like never before.
[*][b]Easy to Play, Difficult to Master:[/b] We've carefully crafted Penny's Big Breakaway to strike the perfect balance between expressiveness and challenge. Dive right into the action and experience a gameplay journey that will put your reflexes, precision, and timing to the ultimate test.
[/list]
Stay tuned for exclusive updates, behind-the-scenes glimpses into our development process, and thrilling surprises as we approach the grand performance of Penny's Big Breakaway. Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist and be among the first to witness the magic unfold.

This is just the beginning of our journey together, and we can't wait to share many more adventures and unforgettable experiences with all of you.

Get ready to break boundaries and light up the stage in Penny's Big Breakaway, coming early 2024!

With heartfelt excitement,
[i]Evening Star[/i]
